captions.detailed: A realistic automotive sunroof cassette module featuring a large black rectangular outer tray frame with rounded corners. Mounted along the left and right sides are grey guide rails and mounting brackets with small cylindrical drain tubes extending outwards from the corners. A central sliding glass panel with a dark border is mounted on the rails, designed to slide longitudinally along the rails in a prismatic motion.
captions.instruction: Generate a detailed automotive car sunroof cassette assembly. It should include a wide black outer support tray, dual longitudinal grey guide rails on the sides with mounting fixtures, and a central rectangular glass sunroof panel with a dark frame that slides back and forth along the guide rails using a prismatic joint.
captions.factory: Construct the main frame using a large thin Box, chamfering or rounding its outer corners, and subtract a central rectangular opening. Model the side guide rails using long extruded profiles or combined Box shapes, adding cylindrical drain tubes at the corners. For the sliding glass, create a central rectangular plate with a contrasting dark border frame, and link the glass panel to the main frame via a prismatic articulation joint aligned along the longitudinal axis.
